caption:
You already paid for the lead.

Find out what you're losing after it arrives.

Enter four numbers: monthly leads, close rate, average job value, and how fast you respond.

The calculator hands back your revenue per lead, what slow follow-up costs you every month, and what a 10% gain in leads, close rate, or repeat business is worth per year.

Most service businesses take hours to call back a new lead. The ones who respond first close far more of them.

This tool shows you exactly where you stand.
